items.name: product-card
items.title: Product card
items.description: A product tile with a second image on hover, colour swatches that swap the photo, and sale pricing.

items.name: product-gallery
items.title: Product gallery
items.description: Main photo with thumbnails, arrow keys, and swipe on touch screens.

items.name: variant-picker
items.title: Variant picker
items.description: Colour swatches and size buttons, with sold-out sizes crossed out and still announced to screen readers.

items.name: size-guide
items.title: Size guide
items.description: A measurement table that switches between centimetres and inches and highlights one size.

items.name: quantity-stepper
items.title: Quantity stepper
items.description: Minus, number, plus. Respects a minimum and maximum, and works with the keyboard.

items.name: add-to-bag
items.title: Add to bag
items.description: The buy button with its states: ready, adding, added, sold out. Announces the result to screen readers.

items.name: bag-drawer
items.title: Bag drawer
items.description: A slide-over bag with line items, quantity controls, subtotal and a checkout button. Traps focus and closes on Escape.

items.name: free-shipping-bar
items.title: Free shipping bar
items.description: A progress bar that says how much more to spend for free shipping, and when it's reached.

items.name: order-summary
items.title: Order summary
items.description: Line items, discount, shipping, tax and total for the bag or checkout page.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: Filter chips and a sort menu for a product listing, with a count and a clear-all button.

items.name: reviews-summary
items.title: Reviews summary
items.description: Average rating, a bar for each star count, and a short list of reviews.

items.name: announcement-bar
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A dismissible strip for one message, such as free shipping or a sale, that remembers it was closed.

items.name: sticky-add-to-bag
items.title: Sticky add to bag
items.description: A bar that slides up from the bottom with the price and buy button once the main one scrolls out of view.

items.name: wishlist-button
items.title: Wishlist button
items.description: A heart that saves a product, with its saved state in the markup and announced to screen readers.

items.name: back-in-stock
items.title: Back in stock
items.description: An email form for a sold-out size that says when the shopper will hear back.

items.name: stock-indicator
items.title: Stock indicator
items.description: In stock, only a few left, sold out or preorder, said in words and not only in colour.

items.name: discount-code
items.title: Discount code
items.description: A field for a discount code that shows the applied code, removes it, and explains why one didn't work.

items.name: address-form
items.title: Address form
items.description: Shipping address fields with the right autofill hints, country list and inline errors.

items.name: delivery-options
items.title: Delivery options
items.description: Shipping methods as radio cards with delivery estimate and price, free ones marked.

items.name: checkout-steps
items.title: Checkout steps
items.description: Where the shopper is in checkout, with finished steps as links back.

items.name: product-search
items.title: Product search
items.description: A search box with product suggestions, keyboard selection, and a no-results state.

items.name: collection-header
items.title: Collection header
items.description: The top of a category page: title, short description, product count and an optional photo.

items.name: mega-menu
items.title: Mega menu
items.description: Store navigation with link columns and a featured product, opened by click or keyboard, closed with Escape.

items.name: breadcrumbs
items.title: Breadcrumbs
items.description: The path to the current page, shortened in the middle on small screens.

items.name: load-more
items.title: Load more
items.description: How many products are shown out of how many, with a progress line and a button for the next batch.

items.name: quick-view
items.title: Quick view
items.description: A product in a dialog from the listing: photo, price, colour and size, and add to bag. Traps focus and closes on Escape.

items.name: reviews-list
items.title: Reviews list
items.description: Full reviews with stars, verified-buyer marks and sorting, a few at a time.

items.name: store-benefits
items.title: Store benefits
items.description: A row of short promises such as free shipping, free returns and secure payment, each with an icon.

items.name: newsletter-signup
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: An email signup with a consent line and clear sending, done and error states.

items.name: virtual-try-on
items.title: Virtual try-on
items.description: The shopper adds a photo and sees the product on themselves. Bring any AI try-on service; the component handles the photo, the wait, the result and the privacy note.

items.name: before-after
items.title: Before and after
items.description: A slider that compares two photos, such as the shopper's photo and the try-on result. Works with drag, touch and arrow keys.

items.name: size-finder
items.title: Size finder
items.description: Height, weight and how the shopper likes it to fit in, a recommended size out, with how close the fit is and why.

items.name: product-spin
items.title: 360° product spin
items.description: Drag or use arrow keys to turn the product, from a set of photos taken around it.

items.name: complete-the-look
items.title: Complete the look
items.description: Products that go with this one, ticked by default, with the total and one button to add them all.
